args:
Fix OutfitCarouselCard.tsx to display flat-lay      
  images instead of mannequin-style product thumbnails. This is a follow-up to the                
  OutfitRecommendationCard fix (spec chore-74e07357). Issue: The outfit discovery grid in         
  apps/web/components/outfit/OutfitCarouselCard.tsx (line 47-54) directly uses outfit.imageUrl    
  which shows mannequin images. Fix: 1) Import FlatLayComposite from                              
  '@/components/outfit/FlatLayComposite' 2) Update image display logic to prioritize flat-lay:    
  First check outfit.flatLayImageUrl or outfit.flatLayImageBase64, then fall back to              
  FlatLayComposite component using outfit.items, never show raw mannequin imageUrl as main card   
  image 3) Match the same fallback priority pattern used in OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx. Expected
   result: All outfit cards in the discovery grid should show flat-lay style composition matching 
  the AI-generated aesthetic per data/personas/prompt_gen/looks.md specification.
output:
Plan file created at: **`specs/chore-12858b29-outfit-carousel-flat-lay.md`**

The plan outlines a 5-step process to fix OutfitCarouselCard.tsx by:

1. Importing the FlatLayComposite component
2. Adding image source detection logic (matching OutfitRecommendationCard pattern)
3. Replacing the image display JSX with three-tier fallback (flat-lay image → FlatLayComposite → placeholder)
4. Updating container styling for flat-lay display
5. Validating TypeScript compilation

This will ensure the outfit discovery grid displays flat-lay format images consistent with the chat panel recommendations, per the looks.md specification.
